description: Signoff inbox: notes which project each session runs in, whether it is working or idle, and whether it waits on you for a permission or an answer. Writes nothing until the Signoff inbox has run on this computer, except, with the Signoff macOS app installed, a link to the plugin's signoff command for the app.

hooks.command: echo `# >$null <#` >/dev/null; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/hooks/hook.sh; [ -r "$f" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$f" start #>
echo `# >$null <#` >/dev/null; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/hooks/hook.sh; [ -r "$f" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$f" session #>
echo `# >$null <#` >/dev/null; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/hooks/hook.sh; [ -r "$f" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$f" clear #>
echo `# >$null <#` >/dev/null; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/hooks/hook.sh; [ -r "$f" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$f" clear #>
